name: hud_ui_background_video_widget_update
description: HudUiBackgroundVideoWidget::Update skips disabled widgets, decodes the elapsed-time-selected FMV frame when a stream is present, forwards the base update, and accumulates elapsed time.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob1 /Zp4 /GX /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?Update@HudUiBackgroundVideoWidget@@QAEXM@Z at 0x4bfe40 still fails: 56 unmasked mismatches, 12 relocation bytes masked, 10 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, BN size 73 bytes, VC object symbol size 80 bytes.

Reviewed triage shows a source-shape/codegen drift in the disabled-bit test and call/epilogue layout; this remains functional-only until the HudUiBackgroundVideoWidget update/function cluster receives an accepted byte comparison.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bfe40 validates the disabled bit 0x10 early return, stream null guard, frame index computed as _ftol(stream->videoFramesPerSecond * elapsedTimeSec) modulo stream->aviVideoFrameCount, zFMV_Stream::ReadAndDecodeFrame dispatch, HudUiElement::Update(deltaTime), and elapsedTimeSec += deltaTime.

Native smoke zhud_background_video_widget_update_smoke verifies the disabled path leaves elapsed time unchanged and skips decoding, the null-stream path still accumulates elapsed time through the base update path, and the stream path calls ReadAndDecodeFrame with frame 5 for fps 12, elapsed 1.25, frame count 10 before accumulating the 0.5 second delta.
